profile_text.body:
Booz Allen Hamilton is a public company, traded as BAH, that describes itself as transforming missions with tomorrow's technologies to advance the country's most critical civil, defense, and national security priorities. Its site states that it has completed its acquisition of the Ultra I&C Mission Solutions business, which now operates as the commercial product and solutions component of Booz Allen's defense technology business. The company says the combined capabilities in battle management, secure communications, encryption, and edge compute will accelerate delivery of interoperable, mission-ready technologies for national security.

The material available does not list specific AI products or MCP servers for the company, and no litigation is recorded.
